BiblicalUsage: When Adonijah tried to take the throne, Rei stood with Zadok the priest, Benaiah and Nathan the prophet, and did not go over to Adonijah. He is named once, among the men who stayed loyal to David.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that loyalty in a contested hour is what makes a name worth remembering.
RelatedPeople: Rei, Officer of David; King David; King Solomon
